abbrev USize := Nat
abbrev Address := Nat
abbrev F32 := Float
abbrev U64 := UInt64

inductive ZigError where
  | OutOfMemory
  | InvalidDimension
  | InvalidLayerCount
  | InvalidConfig
  | ShapeMismatch
  | DataLengthMismatch
  | NonFinite
  | NumericFailure
  | NotInitialized
  | TooLarge
  | BadFileFormat
  | UnsupportedVersion
  | Freed
deriving Repr, Inhabited, DecidableEq

abbrev Heap := Array (Option F32)

abbrev ZM := StateT Heap (Except ZigError)

namespace F32Ops

def zero : F32 := 0.0
def one : F32 := 1.0

def isFinite (x : F32) : Bool := x.isFinite

def clamp (x lo hi : F32) : F32 :=
  if x < lo then lo else if hi < x then hi else x

def sqrt (x : F32) : F32 := Float.sqrt x
def exp (x : F32) : F32 := Float.exp x

end F32Ops

namespace HeapModel

def allocF32Array (size : Nat) : ZM Address := do
  let heap ← get
  let addr := heap.size
  set (heap ++ Array.mkArray size (some 0.0))
  pure addr

def freeF32Array (addr size : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  let heap ← get
  if addr + size > heap.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:size] do
    set (heap.set (addr + i) none)

def writeF32 (addr : Address) (val : F32) : ZM Unit := do
  let heap ← get
  match heap.get? addr with
  | some (some _) => set (heap.set addr (some val))
  | some none => throw ZigError.Freed
  | none => throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch

def readF32 (addr : Address) : ZM F32 := do
  let heap ← get
  match heap.get? addr with
  | some (some v) => pure v
  | some none => throw ZigError.Freed
  | none => throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch

end HeapModel

open HeapModel F32Ops

structure RSFLayerConfig where
  clip_min : F32 := -5.0
  clip_max : F32 := 5.0
  seed_offset : USize := 0
  grad_mean : Bool := true
deriving Repr

structure RSFConfig where
  clip_min : F32 := -5.0
  clip_max : F32 := 5.0
  grad_mean : Bool := true
  max_dim : USize := 1 <<< 20
  max_layers : USize := 1 <<< 20
deriving Repr

structure ZRSFLayer where
  s_weight : ZTensor
  t_weight : ZTensor
  s_bias : ZTensor
  t_bias : ZTensor
  grad_s_weight : ZTensor
  grad_t_weight : ZTensor
  grad_s_bias : ZTensor
  grad_t_bias : ZTensor
  dim : USize
  clip_min : F32
  clip_max : F32
  grad_mean : Bool
deriving Repr

namespace ZRSFLayer

def checkedAddU64 (a b : U64) : Except ZigError U64 :=
  if a.val + b.val < UInt64.max.toNat then .ok ⟨a.val + b.val⟩ else .error ZigError.OutOfMemory

def computeXavierBound (dim : Nat) : F32 :=
  let fan_in : F32 := Float.ofNat dim
  let fan_out : F32 := Float.ofNat dim
  let fan_sum : F32 := fan_in + fan_out
  if fan_sum <= 0.0 then 0.0 else Float.sqrt (6.0 / fan_sum)

def initWithConfig (dim : USize) (cfg : RSFLayerConfig) : ZM ZRSFLayer := do
  if dim = 0 then throw ZigError.InvalidDimension
  if !isFinite cfg.clip_min || !isFinite cfg.clip_max then throw ZigError.NonFinite
  if !(cfg.clip_min < cfg.clip_max) then throw ZigError.InvalidConfig
  let xavier := computeXavierBound dim
  let shapeW : List Nat := [dim, dim]
  let shapeB : List Nat := [1, dim]
  let seed1 ← match checkedAddU64 ⟨42⟩ ⟨cfg.seed_offset⟩ with | .ok s => pure s.val | .error e => throw e
  let seed2 ← match checkedAddU64 ⟨43⟩ ⟨cfg.seed_offset⟩ with | .ok s => pure s.val | .error e => throw e
  let s_weight ← ZTensor.randomUniform shapeW seed1 (-xavier) xavier
  let t_weight ← ZTensor.randomUniform shapeW seed2 (-xavier) xavier
  let s_bias ← ZTensor.zeros shapeB
  let t_bias ← ZTensor.zeros shapeB
  let grad_s_weight ← ZTensor.zeros shapeW
  let grad_t_weight ← ZTensor.zeros shapeW
  let grad_s_bias ← ZTensor.zeros shapeB
  let grad_t_bias ← ZTensor.zeros shapeB
  pure { dim := dim, s_weight := s_weight, t_weight := t_weight, s_bias := s_bias, t_bias := t_bias, grad_s_weight := grad_s_weight, grad_t_weight := grad_t_weight, grad_s_bias := grad_s_bias, grad_t_bias := grad_t_bias, clip_min := cfg.clip_min, clip_max := cfg.clip_max, grad_mean := cfg.grad_mean }

def deinit (self : ZRSFLayer) : ZM Unit := do
  ZTensor.deinit self.s_weight
  ZTensor.deinit self.t_weight
  ZTensor.deinit self.s_bias
  ZTensor.deinit self.t_bias
  ZTensor.deinit self.grad_s_weight
  ZTensor.deinit self.grad_t_weight
  ZTensor.deinit self.grad_s_bias
  ZTensor.deinit self.grad_t_bias

def zeroGradients (self : ZRSFLayer) : ZM Unit := do
  for i in [:self.grad_s_weight.size] do writeF32 (self.grad_s_weight.dataPtr + i) 0.0
  for i in [:self.grad_t_weight.size] do writeF32 (self.grad_t_weight.dataPtr + i) 0.0
  for i in [:self.grad_s_bias.size] do writeF32 (self.grad_s_bias.dataPtr + i) 0.0
  for i in [:self.grad_t_bias.size] do writeF32 (self.grad_t_bias.dataPtr + i) 0.0

def assert2DAndLen (t : ZTensor) : ZM (Nat × Nat) := do
  match t.shape with
  | [r, c] => if t.size = r * c then pure (r, c) else throw ZigError.DataLengthMismatch
  | _ => throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch

def assertPair (self : ZRSFLayer) (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Nat := do
  let (ar, ac) ← assert2DAndLen a
  let (br, bc) ← assert2DAndLen b
  if ac ≠ self.dim ∨ bc ≠ self.dim then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  if ar ≠ br then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  if self.s_bias.size ≠ self.dim ∨ self.t_bias.size ≠ self.dim then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  if !isFinite self.clip_min ∨ !isFinite self.clip_max then throw ZigError.NonFinite
  if !(self.clip_min < self.clip_max) then throw ZigError.InvalidConfig
  pure ar

def clampFiniteInPlace (t : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  for i in [:t.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i)
    if !isFinite v then writeF32 (t.dataPtr + i) 0.0

def forward (self : ZRSFLayer) (x1 x2 : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  let batch_size ← assertPair self x1 x2
  let x2_t ← transpose2D x2
  let s_x2_t ← matmul2D self.s_weight x2_t
  let s_x2 ← transpose2D s_x2_t
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (s_x2.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (s_x2.dataPtr + idx) (v + (← readF32 (self.s_bias.dataPtr + d)))
  clampFiniteInPlace s_x2
  clip2D s_x2 self.clip_min self.clip_max
  clampFiniteInPlace s_x2
  exp2D s_x2
  clampFiniteInPlace s_x2
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v1 ← readF32 (x1.dataPtr + idx)
      let s ← readF32 (s_x2.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (x1.dataPtr + idx) (v1 * s)
  let x1_t ← transpose2D x1
  let t_x1_t ← matmul2D self.t_weight x1_t
  let t_x1 ← transpose2D t_x1_t
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (t_x1.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (t_x1.dataPtr + idx) (v + (← readF32 (self.t_bias.dataPtr + d)))
  clampFiniteInPlace t_x1
  add2D x2 t_x1
  clampFiniteInPlace x2

def checkAllNonzeroFinite (t : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  for i in [:t.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i)
    if v = 0.0 ∨ !isFinite v then throw ZigError.NumericFailure

def inverse (self : ZRSFLayer) (y1 y2 : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  let batch_size ← assertPair self y1 y2
  let y1_t ← transpose2D y1
  let t_y1_t ← matmul2D self.t_weight y1_t
  let t_y1 ← transpose2D t_y1_t
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (t_y1.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (t_y1.dataPtr + idx) (v + (← readF32 (self.t_bias.dataPtr + d)))
  clampFiniteInPlace t_y1
  sub2D y2 t_y1
  clampFiniteInPlace y2
  let y2_t ← transpose2D y2
  let s_y2_t ← matmul2D self.s_weight y2_t
  let s_y2 ← transpose2D s_y2_t
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (s_y2.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (s_y2.dataPtr + idx) (v + (← readF32 (self.s_bias.dataPtr + d)))
  clampFiniteInPlace s_y2
  clip2D s_y2 self.clip_min self.clip_max
  clampFiniteInPlace s_y2
  exp2D s_y2
  clampFiniteInPlace s_y2
  checkAllNonzeroFinite s_y2
  div2D y1 s_y2
  clampFiniteInPlace y1

def compute_t_y1 (self : ZRSFLayer) (y1 : ZTensor) (batch_size : Nat) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let y1_t ← transpose2D y1
  let t_y1_t ← matmul2D self.t_weight y1_t
  let t_y1 ← transpose2D t_y1_t
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (t_y1.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (t_y1.dataPtr + idx) (v + (← readF32 (self.t_bias.dataPtr + d)))
  clampFiniteInPlace t_y1
  pure t_y1

def compute_x2 (y2 t_y1 : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let x2 ← copy2D y2
  sub2D x2 t_y1
  clampFiniteInPlace x2
  pure x2

def accumulate_t_grads (self : ZRSFLayer) (dy2 y1 : ZTensor) (batch_size : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  let dy2_t ← transpose2D dy2
  let dt ← matmul2D dy2_t y1
  let grad_scale : F32 := if self.grad_mean then 1.0 / Float.ofNat batch_size else 1.0
  for i in [:dt.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (dt.dataPtr + i)
    let g ← readF32 (self.grad_t_weight.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (self.grad_t_weight.dataPtr + i) (g + v * grad_scale)
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (dy2.dataPtr + idx)
      let g ← readF32 (self.grad_t_bias.dataPtr + d)
      writeF32 (self.grad_t_bias.dataPtr + d) (g + v * grad_scale)

def compute_grad_from_t (self : ZRSFLayer) (dy2 : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let dy2_t ← transpose2D dy2
  let t_weight_t ← transpose2D self.t_weight
  let grad_from_t_t ← matmul2D t_weight_t dy2_t
  let grad_from_t ← transpose2D grad_from_t_t
  pure grad_from_t

def compute_s_pre (self : ZRSFLayer) (x2 : ZTensor) (batch_size : Nat) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let x2_t ← transpose2D x2
  let s_pre_t ← matmul2D self.s_weight x2_t
  let s_pre ← transpose2D s_pre_t
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (s_pre.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (s_pre.dataPtr + idx) (v + (← readF32 (self.s_bias.dataPtr + d)))
  clampFiniteInPlace s_pre
  pure s_pre

def compute_exp_s (s_pre : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let s_clipped ← copy2D s_pre
  clip2D s_clipped self.clip_min self.clip_max
  clampFiniteInPlace s_clipped
  let exp_s ← copy2D s_clipped
  exp2D exp_s
  clampFiniteInPlace exp_s
  pure exp_s

def compute_x1 (y1 exp_s : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let x1 ← copy2D y1
  div2D x1 exp_s
  clampFiniteInPlace x1
  pure x1

def write_outs (x1_out x2_out x1 x2 : ZTensor) (batch_size : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v1 ← readF32 (x1.dataPtr + idx)
      let v2 ← readF32 (x2.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (x1_out.dataPtr + idx) v1
      writeF32 (x2_out.dataPtr + idx) v2

def compute_dx1 (dy1 exp_s : ZTensor) (dx1_out : ZTensor) (batch_size : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (dy1.dataPtr + idx)
      let s ← readF32 (exp_s.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (dx1_out.dataPtr + idx) (v * s)

def compute_ds (dy1 x1 exp_s s_pre : ZTensor) (batch_size : Nat) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let dscale ← copy2D dy1
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (dscale.dataPtr + idx)
      let x ← readF32 (x1.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (dscale.dataPtr + idx) (v * x)
  let ds ← copy2D dscale
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (ds.dataPtr + idx)
      let e ← readF32 (exp_s.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (ds.dataPtr + idx) (v * e)
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (s_pre.dataPtr + idx)
      if !isFinite v ∨ v < self.clip_min ∨ v > self.clip_max then
        writeF32 (ds.dataPtr + idx) 0.0
  pure ds

def accumulate_s_grads (self : ZRSFLayer) (ds x2 : ZTensor) (batch_size : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  let ds_t ← transpose2D ds
  let ds_w ← matmul2D ds_t x2
  let grad_scale : F32 := if self.grad_mean then 1.0 / Float.ofNat batch_size else 1.0
  for i in [:ds_w.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (ds_w.dataPtr + i)
    let g ← readF32 (self.grad_s_weight.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (self.grad_s_weight.dataPtr + i) (g + v * grad_scale)
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (ds.dataPtr + idx)
      let g ← readF32 (self.grad_s_bias.dataPtr + d)
      writeF32 (self.grad_s_bias.dataPtr + d) (g + v * grad_scale)

def compute_dx2 (dy2 grad_from_s : ZTensor) (dx2_out : ZTensor) (batch_size : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  for b in [:batch_size] do
    for d in [:self.dim] do
      let idx := b * self.dim + d
      let v ← readF32 (dy2.dataPtr + idx)
      let g ← readF32 (grad_from_s.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (dx2_out.dataPtr + idx) (v + g)

def compute_grad_from_s (self : ZRSFLayer) (ds : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let ds_t ← transpose2D ds
  let s_weight_t ← transpose2D self.s_weight
  let grad_from_s_t ← matmul2D s_weight_t ds_t
  let grad_from_s ← transpose2D grad_from_s_t
  pure grad_from_s

def backward (self : ZRSFLayer) (y1 y2 dy1_in dy2_in x1_out x2_out dx1_out dx2_out : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  let batch_size ← assertPair self y1 y2
  let _ ← assertPair self dy1_in dy2_in
  let _ ← assert2DAndLen x1_out
  let _ ← assert2DAndLen x2_out
  let _ ← assert2DAndLen dx1_out
  let _ ← assert2DAndLen dx2_out
  if x1_out.shape ≠ [batch_size, self.dim] ∨ x2_out.shape ≠ [batch_size, self.dim] ∨ dx1_out.shape ≠ [batch_size, self.dim] ∨ dx2_out.shape ≠ [batch_size, self.dim] then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  if x1_out.size ≠ batch_size * self.dim ∨ x2_out.size ≠ batch_size * self.dim ∨ dx1_out.size ≠ batch_size * self.dim ∨ dx2_out.size ≠ batch_size * self.dim then throw ZigError.DataLengthMismatch
  let dy1 ← copy2D dy1_in
  let dy2 ← copy2D dy2_in
  let t_y1 ← compute_t_y1 self y1 batch_size
  let x2 ← compute_x2 y2 t_y1
  accumulate_t_grads self dy2 y1 batch_size
  let grad_from_t ← compute_grad_from_t self dy2
  add2D dy1 grad_from_t
  clampFiniteInPlace dy1
  let s_pre ← compute_s_pre self x2 batch_size
  let exp_s ← compute_exp_s s_pre
  checkAllNonzeroFinite exp_s
  let x1 ← compute_x1 y1 exp_s
  write_outs x1_out x2_out x1 x2 batch_size
  compute_dx1 dy1 exp_s dx1_out batch_size
  let ds ← compute_ds dy1 x1 exp_s s_pre batch_size
  accumulate_s_grads self ds x2 batch_size
  let grad_from_s ← compute_grad_from_s self ds
  compute_dx2 dy2 grad_from_s dx2_out batch_size
  clampFiniteInPlace dx1_out
  clampFiniteInPlace dx2_out

end ZRSFLayer

structure ZControlBlock where
  freed : Bool
  dim : Nat
  num_layers : Nat
  layers : Array ZRSFLayer
  cfg : RSFConfig
deriving Repr

structure ZRSF where
  ctrl : ZControlBlock
deriving Repr

namespace ZRSF

def initWithConfig (dim : Nat) (num_layers : Nat) (cfg : RSFConfig) : ZM ZRSF := do
  if dim = 0 then throw ZigError.InvalidDimension
  if num_layers = 0 then throw ZigError.InvalidLayerCount
  if dim > cfg.max_dim ∨ num_layers > cfg.max_layers then throw ZigError.TooLarge
  if !isFinite cfg.clip_min ∨ !isFinite cfg.clip_max then throw ZigError.NonFinite
  if !(cfg.clip_min < cfg.clip_max) then throw ZigError.InvalidConfig
  let mut layers : Array ZRSFLayer := #[]
  for l in [:num_layers] do
    let lc : RSFLayerConfig := { clip_min := cfg.clip_min, clip_max := cfg.clip_max, seed_offset := l * 1000, grad_mean := cfg.grad_mean }
    let layer ← ZRSFLayer.initWithConfig dim lc
    layers := layers.push layer
  pure { ctrl := { freed := false, dim := dim, num_layers := num_layers, layers := layers, cfg := cfg } }

def deinit (self : ZRSF) : ZM ZRSF := do
  if self.ctrl.freed then pure self else do
    for layer in self.ctrl.layers do ZRSFLayer.deinit layer
    pure { ctrl := { self.ctrl with freed := true } }

def ensureNotFreed (self : ZRSF) : ZM Unit := do
  if self.ctrl.freed then throw ZigError.NotInitialized else pure ()

def assert2DAndLen (t : ZTensor) : ZM (Nat × Nat) := ZRSFLayer.assert2DAndLen t

def split (self : ZRSF) (x : ZTensor) (x1 x2 : ZTensor) : ZM Nat := do
  let (batch, dim2) ← assert2DAndLen x
  if dim2 ≠ 2 * self.ctrl.dim then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  let (b1, d1) ← assert2DAndLen x1
  let (b2, d2) ← assert2DAndLen x2
  if b1 ≠ batch ∨ b2 ≠ batch ∨ d1 ≠ self.ctrl.dim ∨ d2 ≠ self.ctrl.dim then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  if x1.size ≠ batch * self.ctrl.dim ∨ x2.size ≠ batch * self.ctrl.dim then throw ZigError.DataLengthMismatch
  for b in [:batch] do
    for d in [:self.ctrl.dim] do
      let idx := b * (2 * self.ctrl.dim) + d
      let idx1 := b * self.ctrl.dim + d
      let v1 ← readF32 (x.dataPtr + idx)
      writeF32 (x1.dataPtr + idx1) v1
      let v2 ← readF32 (x.dataPtr + idx + self.ctrl.dim)
      writeF32 (x2.dataPtr + idx1) v2
  pure batch

def merge (self : ZRSF) (x1 x2 : ZTensor) (out : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  let (b1, d1) ← assert2DAndLen x1
  let (b2, d2) ← assert2DAndLen x2
  let (bo, do) ← assert2DAndLen out
  if b1 ≠ b2 ∨ b1 ≠ bo ∨ d1 ≠ self.ctrl.dim ∨ d2 ≠ self.ctrl.dim ∨ do ≠ 2 * self.ctrl.dim then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for b in [:b1] do
    for d in [:self.ctrl.dim] do
      let idx1 := b * self.ctrl.dim + d
      let idx := b * (2 * self.ctrl.dim) + d
      let v1 ← readF32 (x1.dataPtr + idx1)
      let v2 ← readF32 (x2.dataPtr + idx1)
      writeF32 (out.dataPtr + idx) v1
      writeF32 (out.dataPtr + idx + self.ctrl.dim) v2

def zeroGradients (self : ZRSF) : ZM Unit := do
  ensureNotFreed self
  for layer in self.ctrl.layers do
    ZRSFLayer.zeroGradients layer

def forward (self : ZRSF) (x : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  ensureNotFreed self
  let (batch, dim2) ← assert2DAndLen x
  if dim2 ≠ 2 * self.ctrl.dim then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  let x1 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let x2 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let _ ← split self x x1 x2
  for layer in self.ctrl.layers do
    ZRSFLayer.forward layer x1 x2
  merge self x1 x2 x

def inverse (self : ZRSF) (y : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  ensureNotFreed self
  let (batch, dim2) ← assert2DAndLen y
  if dim2 ≠ 2 * self.ctrl.dim then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  let y1 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let y2 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let _ ← split self y y1 y2
  for layer in self.ctrl.layers.reverse do
    ZRSFLayer.inverse layer y1 y2
  merge self y1 y2 y

def backward (self : ZRSF) (grad_output input grad_input_out : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  ensureNotFreed self
  let (bi, di) ← assert2DAndLen input
  let (bg, dg) ← assert2DAndLen grad_output
  let (bo, do) ← assert2DAndLen grad_input_out
  if di ≠ 2 * self.ctrl.dim ∨ bi ≠ bg ∨ bi ≠ bo ∨ dg ≠ di ∨ do ≠ di then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  let batch := bi
  let x ← copy2D input
  forward self x
  let y1 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let y2 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let _ ← split self x y1 y2
  let dy1 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let dy2 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let _ ← split self grad_output dy1 dy2
  let mut cur_y1 := ← copy2D y1
  let mut cur_y2 := ← copy2D y2
  let mut cur_dy1 := ← copy2D dy1
  let mut cur_dy2 := ← copy2D dy2
  let x1_prev ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let x2_prev ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let dx1_prev ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let dx2_prev ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  for layer in self.ctrl.layers.reverse do
    ZRSFLayer.backward layer cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 x1_prev x2_prev dx1_prev dx2_prev
    let tmp_y1 := cur_y1
    cur_y1 := x1_prev
    x1_prev := tmp_y1
    let tmp_y2 := cur_y2
    cur_y2 := x2_prev
    x2_prev := tmp_y2
    let tmp_dy1 := cur_dy1
    cur_dy1 := dx1_prev
    dx1_prev := tmp_dy1
    let tmp_dy2 := cur_dy2
    cur_dy2 := dx2_prev
    dx2_prev := tmp_dy2
  merge self cur_dy1 cur_dy2 grad_input_out

def encodeRSF (self : ZRSF) : ByteArray := do
  let mut ba := ByteArray.empty
  ba := ba.append "RSF0".toUTF8
  ba := encodeU32LE ba 1
  ba := encodeU64LE ba self.ctrl.num_layers
  ba := encodeU64LE ba self.ctrl.dim
  ba := encodeF32Bits ba self.ctrl.cfg.clip_min
  ba := encodeF32Bits ba self.ctrl.cfg.clip_max
  ba := encodeBoolByte ba self.ctrl.cfg.grad_mean
  for layer in self.ctrl.layers do
    ba := encodeF32Bits ba layer.clip_min
    ba := encodeF32Bits ba layer.clip_max
    ba := encodeBoolByte ba layer.grad_mean
    ba := encodeTensor ba layer.s_weight
    ba := encodeTensor ba layer.t_weight
    ba := encodeTensor ba layer.s_bias
    ba := encodeTensor ba layer.t_bias
  ba

def decodeRSF (ba : ByteArray) : Except ZigError ZRSF := do
  let mut pos := 0
  let (magic, p) ← decodeString ba pos 4
  pos := p
  if magic ≠ "RSF0" then .error ZigError.BadFileFormat
  let (version, p) ← decodeU32LE ba pos
  pos := p
  if version ≠ 1 then .error ZigError.UnsupportedVersion
  let (num_layers, p) ← decodeU64LE ba pos
  pos := p
  let (dim, p) ← decodeU64LE ba pos
  pos := p
  if num_layers = 0 ∨ dim = 0 then .error ZigError.InvalidDimension
  if num_layers > 1 <<< 20 ∨ dim > 1 <<< 20 then .error ZigError.TooLarge
  let (clip_min, p) ← decodeF32Bits ba pos
  pos := p
  let (clip_max, p) ← decodeF32Bits ba pos
  pos := p
  let (grad_mean, p) ← decodeBoolByte ba pos
  pos := p
  if !isFinite clip_min ∨ !isFinite clip_max ∨ !(clip_min < clip_max) then .error ZigError.InvalidConfig
  let cfg : RSFConfig := { clip_min := clip_min, clip_max := clip_max, grad_mean := grad_mean }
  let mut layers : Array ZRSFLayer := #[]
  for _ in [:num_layers] do
    let (l_clip_min, p) ← decodeF32Bits ba pos
    pos := p
    let (l_clip_max, p) ← decodeF32Bits ba pos
    pos := p
    let (l_grad_mean, p) ← decodeBoolByte ba pos
    pos := p
    if !isFinite l_clip_min ∨ !isFinite l_clip_max ∨ !(l_clip_min < l_clip_max) then .error ZigError.InvalidConfig
    let (s_w, p) ← decodeTensor ba pos
    pos := p
    let (t_w, p) ← decodeTensor ba pos
    pos := p
    let (s_b, p) ← decodeTensor ba pos
    pos := p
    let (t_b, p) ← decodeTensor ba pos
    pos := p
    if s_w.shape ≠ [dim, dim] ∨ t_w.shape ≠ [dim, dim] ∨ s_b.shape ≠ [1, dim] ∨ t_b.shape ≠ [1, dim] then .error ZigError.ShapeMismatch
    let lc : RSFLayerConfig := { clip_min := l_clip_min, clip_max := l_clip_max, grad_mean := l_grad_mean }
    let layer ← ZRSFLayer.initWithConfig dim lc
    layer.s_weight := s_w
    layer.t_weight := t_w
    layer.s_bias := s_b
    layer.t_bias := t_b
    layers := layers.push layer
  .ok { ctrl := { freed := false, dim := dim, num_layers := num_layers, layers := layers, cfg := cfg } }

end ZRSF

namespace ZTensor

def totalSize (shape : List Nat) : Nat :=
  shape.foldl (· * ·) 1

def zeros (shape : List Nat) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let sz := totalSize shape
  if sz = 0 then throw ZigError.InvalidDimension
  let addr ← allocF32Array sz
  pure { dataPtr := addr, size := sz, shape := shape }

def rngStep (seed : USize) : USize :=
  seed * 1103515245 + 12345

def uniform (seed : USize) : F32 :=
  let n := seed % 2147483648
  Float.ofNat n / 2147483648.0

def randomUniform (shape : List Nat) (seed : USize) (low high : F32) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let t ← zeros shape
  let range := high - low
  let mut cur_seed := seed
  for i in [:t.size] do
    cur_seed := rngStep cur_seed
    let u := uniform cur_seed
    let v := low + range * u
    writeF32 (t.dataPtr + i) v
  pure t

def deinit (t : ZTensor) : ZM Unit :=
  freeF32Array t.dataPtr t.size

def copy2D (t : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let out ← zeros t.shape
  for i in [:t.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (out.dataPtr + i) v
  pure out

def add2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  if a.size ≠ b.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:a.size] do
    let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i)
    let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (a.dataPtr + i) (va + vb)

def sub2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  if a.size ≠ b.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:a.size] do
    let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i)
    let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (a.dataPtr + i) (va - vb)

def mulElem2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  if a.size ≠ b.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:a.size] do
    let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i)
    let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (a.dataPtr + i) (va * vb)

def divElem2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  if a.size ≠ b.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:a.size] do
    let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i)
    let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (a.dataPtr + i) (va / vb)

def clip2D (t : ZTensor) (lo hi : F32) : ZM Unit := do
  for i in [:t.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (t.dataPtr + i) (clamp v lo hi)

def exp2D (t : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  for i in [:t.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (t.dataPtr + i) (Float.exp v)

def transpose2D (t : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  match t.shape with
  | [rows, cols] =>
      let out ← zeros [cols, rows]
      for r in [:rows] do
        for c in [:cols] do
          let src := r * cols + c
          let dst := c * rows + r
          let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + src)
          writeF32 (out.dataPtr + dst) v
      pure out
  | _ => throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch

def matmul2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  match a.shape, b.shape with
  | [m, k1], [k2, n] =>
      if k1 ≠ k2 then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
      let out ← zeros [m, n]
      for i in [:m] do
        for j in [:n] do
          let mut sum : F32 := 0.0
          for k in [:k1] do
            let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i * k1 + k)
            let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + k * n + j)
            sum := sum + va * vb
          writeF32 (out.dataPtr + i * n + j) sum
      pure out
  | _, _ => throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch

end ZTensor

open Std

abbrev ByteArray := Array UInt8

def encodeU32LE (ba : ByteArray) (x : UInt32) : ByteArray :=
  ba.push (x.toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 8).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 16).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 24).toUInt8)

def decodeU32LE (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (UInt32 × Nat) :=
  if pos + 4 > ba.size then .error ZigError.DataLengthMismatch else
    .ok (⟨ba[pos] + (ba[pos+1] <<< 8) + (ba[pos+2] <<< 16) + (ba[pos+3] <<< 24)⟩, pos + 4)

def encodeU64LE (ba : ByteArray) (x : UInt64) : ByteArray :=
  ba.push (x.toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 8).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 16).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 24).toUInt8)
    |>.push ((x >>> 32).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 40).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 48).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 56).toUInt8)

def decodeU64LE (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (UInt64 × Nat) :=
  if pos + 8 > ba.size then .error ZigError.DataLengthMismatch else
    .ok (⟨ba[pos] + (ba[pos+1] <<< 8) + (ba[pos+2] <<< 16) + (ba[pos+3] <<< 24) + (ba[pos+4] <<< 32) + (ba[pos+5] <<< 40) + (ba[pos+6] <<< 48) + (ba[pos+7] <<< 56)⟩, pos + 8)

def encodeF32Bits (ba : ByteArray) (f : Float) : ByteArray :=
  encodeU32LE ba ⟨Float.toBits f⟩

def decodeF32Bits (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (Float × Nat) := do
  let (u, p) ← decodeU32LE ba pos
  .ok (Float.ofBits u.val, p)

def encodeBoolByte (ba : ByteArray) (b : Bool) : ByteArray :=
  ba.push (if b then 1 else 0)

def decodeBoolByte (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (Bool × Nat) :=
  if pos + 1 > ba.size then .error ZigError.DataLengthMismatch else
    .ok (ba[pos] ≠ 0, pos + 1)

def encodeString (ba : ByteArray) (s : String) : ByteArray :=
  ba.append s.toUTF8

def decodeString (ba : ByteArray) (pos len : Nat) : Except ZigError (String × Nat) :=
  if pos + len > ba.size then .error ZigError.DataLengthMismatch else
    .ok (String.fromUTF8Unchecked (ba.slice pos len), pos + len)

def encodeTensor (ba : ByteArray) (t : ZTensor) : ByteArray := do
  let mut b := ba
  b := encodeU64LE b t.shape.length
  for d in t.shape do
    b := encodeU64LE b d
  b := encodeU64LE b t.size
  for i in [:t.size] do
    b := encodeF32Bits b (← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i))
  b

def decodeTensor (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (ZTensor × Nat) := do
  let (ndim, p) ← decodeU64LE ba pos
  let mut shape : List Nat := []
  let mut pp := p
  for _ in [:ndim.val] do
    let (d, q) ← decodeU64LE ba pp
    shape := shape ++ [d.val]
    pp := q
  let (size, q) ← decodeU64LE ba pp
  let mut data : Array F32 := #[]
  pp := q
  for _ in [:size.val] do
    let (f, r) ← decodeF32Bits ba pp
    data := data.push f
    pp := r
  let addr ← allocF32Array size.val
  for i in [:size.val] do
    writeF32 (addr + i) data[i]
  .ok ({ dataPtr := addr, size := size.val, shape := shape }, pp)

  ensureNotFreed self
  let (batch, dim2) ← assert2DAndLen y
  if dim2 ≠ 2 * self.ctrl.dim then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  let y1 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let y2 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let _ ← split self y y1 y2
  for layer in self.ctrl.layers.reverse do
    ZRSFLayer.inverse layer y1 y2
  merge self y1 y2 y

def backward (self : ZRSF) (grad_output input grad_input_out : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  ensureNotFreed self
  let (bi, di) ← assert2DAndLen input
  let (bg, dg) ← assert2DAndLen grad_output
  let (bo, do) ← assert2DAndLen grad_input_out
  if di ≠ 2 * self.ctrl.dim ∨ bi ≠ bg ∨ bi ≠ bo ∨ dg ≠ di ∨ do ≠ di then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  let batch := bi
  let x ← copy2D input
  forward self x
  let y1 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let y2 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let _ ← split self x y1 y2
  let dy1 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let dy2 ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let _ ← split self grad_output dy1 dy2
  let mut cur_y1 := ← copy2D y1
  let mut cur_y2 := ← copy2D y2
  let mut cur_dy1 := ← copy2D dy1
  let mut cur_dy2 := ← copy2D dy2
  let x1_prev ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let x2_prev ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let dx1_prev ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  let dx2_prev ← ZTensor.zeros [batch, self.ctrl.dim]
  for layer in self.ctrl.layers.reverse do
    ZRSFLayer.backward layer cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 x1_prev x2_prev dx1_prev dx2_prev
    let tmp_y1 := cur_y1
    cur_y1 := x1_prev
    x1_prev := tmp_y1
    let tmp_y2 := cur_y2
    cur_y2 := x2_prev
    x2_prev := tmp_y2
    let tmp_dy1 := cur_dy1
    cur_dy1 := dx1_prev
    dx1_prev := tmp_dy1
    let tmp_dy2 := cur_dy2
    cur_dy2 := dx2_prev
    dx2_prev := tmp_dy2
  merge self cur_dy1 cur_dy2 grad_input_out

def encodeRSF (self : ZRSF) : ByteArray := do
  let mut ba := ByteArray.empty
  ba := ba.append "RSF0".toUTF8
  ba := encodeU32LE ba 1
  ba := encodeU64LE ba self.ctrl.num_layers
  ba := encodeU64LE ba self.ctrl.dim
  ba := encodeF32Bits ba self.ctrl.cfg.clip_min
  ba := encodeF32Bits ba self.ctrl.cfg.clip_max
  ba := encodeBoolByte ba self.ctrl.cfg.grad_mean
  for layer in self.ctrl.layers do
    ba := encodeF32Bits ba layer.clip_min
    ba := encodeF32Bits ba layer.clip_max
    ba := encodeBoolByte ba layer.grad_mean
    ba := encodeTensor ba layer.s_weight
    ba := encodeTensor ba layer.t_weight
    ba := encodeTensor ba layer.s_bias
    ba := encodeTensor ba layer.t_bias
  ba

def decodeRSF (ba : ByteArray) : Except ZigError ZRSF := do
  let mut pos := 0
  let (magic, p) ← decodeString ba pos 4
  pos := p
  if magic ≠ "RSF0" then .error ZigError.BadFileFormat
  let (version, p) ← decodeU32LE ba pos
  pos := p
  if version ≠ 1 then .error ZigError.UnsupportedVersion
  let (num_layers, p) ← decodeU64LE ba pos
  pos := p
  let (dim, p) ← decodeU64LE ba pos
  pos := p
  if num_layers = 0 ∨ dim = 0 then .error ZigError.InvalidDimension
  if num_layers > 1 <<< 20 ∨ dim > 1 <<< 20 then .error ZigError.TooLarge
  let (clip_min, p) ← decodeF32Bits ba pos
  pos := p
  let (clip_max, p) ← decodeF32Bits ba pos
  pos := p
  let (grad_mean, p) ← decodeBoolByte ba pos
  pos := p
  if !isFinite clip_min ∨ !isFinite clip_max ∨ !(clip_min < clip_max) then .error ZigError.InvalidConfig
  let cfg : RSFConfig := { clip_min := clip_min, clip_max := clip_max, grad_mean := grad_mean }
  let mut layers : Array ZRSFLayer := #[]
  for _ in [:num_layers] do
    let (l_clip_min, p) ← decodeF32Bits ba pos
    pos := p
    let (l_clip_max, p) ← decodeF32Bits ba pos
    pos := p
    let (l_grad_mean, p) ← decodeBoolByte ba pos
    pos := p
    if !isFinite l_clip_min ∨ !isFinite l_clip_max ∨ !(l_clip_min < l_clip_max) then .error ZigError.InvalidConfig
    let (s_w, p) ← decodeTensor ba pos
    pos := p
    let (t_w, p) ← decodeTensor ba pos
    pos := p
    let (s_b, p) ← decodeTensor ba pos
    pos := p
    let (t_b, p) ← decodeTensor ba pos
    pos := p
    if s_w.shape ≠ [dim, dim] ∨ t_w.shape ≠ [dim, dim] ∨ s_b.shape ≠ [1, dim] ∨ t_b.shape ≠ [1, dim] then .error ZigError.ShapeMismatch
    let lc : RSFLayerConfig := { clip_min := l_clip_min, clip_max := l_clip_max, grad_mean := l_grad_mean }
    let layer ← ZRSFLayer.initWithConfig dim lc
    layer.s_weight := s_w
    layer.t_weight := t_w
    layer.s_bias := s_b
    layer.t_bias := t_b
    layers := layers.push layer
  .ok { ctrl := { freed := false, dim := dim, num_layers := num_layers, layers := layers, cfg := cfg } }

end ZRSF

namespace ZTensor

def totalSize (shape : List Nat) : Nat :=
  shape.foldl (· * ·) 1

def zeros (shape : List Nat) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let sz := totalSize shape
  if sz = 0 then throw ZigError.InvalidDimension
  let addr ← allocF32Array sz
  pure { dataPtr := addr, size := sz, shape := shape }

def rngStep (seed : USize) : USize :=
  seed * 1103515245 + 12345

def uniform (seed : USize) : F32 :=
  let n := seed % 2147483648
  Float.ofNat n / 2147483648.0

def randomUniform (shape : List Nat) (seed : USize) (low high : F32) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let t ← zeros shape
  let range := high - low
  let mut cur_seed := seed
  for i in [:t.size] do
    cur_seed := rngStep cur_seed
    let u := uniform cur_seed
    let v := low + range * u
    writeF32 (t.dataPtr + i) v
  pure t

def deinit (t : ZTensor) : ZM Unit :=
  freeF32Array t.dataPtr t.size

def copy2D (t : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  let out ← zeros t.shape
  for i in [:t.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (out.dataPtr + i) v
  pure out

def add2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  if a.size ≠ b.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:a.size] do
    let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i)
    let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (a.dataPtr + i) (va + vb)

def sub2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  if a.size ≠ b.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:a.size] do
    let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i)
    let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (a.dataPtr + i) (va - vb)

def mulElem2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  if a.size ≠ b.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:a.size] do
    let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i)
    let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (a.dataPtr + i) (va * vb)

def divElem2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  if a.size ≠ b.size then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
  for i in [:a.size] do
    let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i)
    let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (a.dataPtr + i) (va / vb)

def clip2D (t : ZTensor) (lo hi : F32) : ZM Unit := do
  for i in [:t.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (t.dataPtr + i) (clamp v lo hi)

def exp2D (t : ZTensor) : ZM Unit := do
  for i in [:t.size] do
    let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i)
    writeF32 (t.dataPtr + i) (Float.exp v)

def transpose2D (t : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  match t.shape with
  | [rows, cols] =>
      let out ← zeros [cols, rows]
      for r in [:rows] do
        for c in [:cols] do
          let src := r * cols + c
          let dst := c * rows + r
          let v ← readF32 (t.dataPtr + src)
          writeF32 (out.dataPtr + dst) v
      pure out
  | _ => throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch

def matmul2D (a b : ZTensor) : ZM ZTensor := do
  match a.shape, b.shape with
  | [m, k1], [k2, n] =>
      if k1 ≠ k2 then throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch
      let out ← zeros [m, n]
      for i in [:m] do
        for j in [:n] do
          let mut sum : F32 := 0.0
          for k in [:k1] do
            let va ← readF32 (a.dataPtr + i * k1 + k)
            let vb ← readF32 (b.dataPtr + k * n + j)
            sum := sum + va * vb
          writeF32 (out.dataPtr + i * n + j) sum
      pure out
  | _, _ => throw ZigError.ShapeMismatch

end ZTensor

open Std

abbrev ByteArray := Array UInt8

def encodeU32LE (ba : ByteArray) (x : UInt32) : ByteArray :=
  ba.push (x.toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 8).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 16).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 24).toUInt8)

def decodeU32LE (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (UInt32 × Nat) :=
  if pos + 4 > ba.size then .error ZigError.DataLengthMismatch else
    .ok (⟨ba[pos] + (ba[pos+1] <<< 8) + (ba[pos+2] <<< 16) + (ba[pos+3] <<< 24)⟩, pos + 4)

def encodeU64LE (ba : ByteArray) (x : UInt64) : ByteArray :=
  ba.push (x.toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 8).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 16).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 24).toUInt8)
    |>.push ((x >>> 32).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 40).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 48).toUInt8) |>.push ((x >>> 56).toUInt8)

def decodeU64LE (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (UInt64 × Nat) :=
  if pos + 8 > ba.size then .error ZigError.DataLengthMismatch else
    .ok (⟨ba[pos] + (ba[pos+1] <<< 8) + (ba[pos+2] <<< 16) + (ba[pos+3] <<< 24) + (ba[pos+4] <<< 32) + (ba[pos+5] <<< 40) + (ba[pos+6] <<< 48) + (ba[pos+7] <<< 56)⟩, pos + 8)

def encodeF32Bits (ba : ByteArray) (f : Float) : ByteArray :=
  encodeU32LE ba ⟨Float.toBits f⟩

def decodeF32Bits (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (Float × Nat) := do
  let (u, p) ← decodeU32LE ba pos
  .ok (Float.ofBits u.val, p)

def encodeBoolByte (ba : ByteArray) (b : Bool) : ByteArray :=
  ba.push (if b then 1 else 0)

def decodeBoolByte (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (Bool × Nat) :=
  if pos + 1 > ba.size then .error ZigError.DataLengthMismatch else
    .ok (ba[pos] ≠ 0, pos + 1)

def encodeString (ba : ByteArray) (s : String) : ByteArray :=
  ba.append s.toUTF8

def decodeString (ba : ByteArray) (pos len : Nat) : Except ZigError (String × Nat) :=
  if pos + len > ba.size then .error ZigError.DataLengthMismatch else
    .ok (String.fromUTF8Unchecked (ba.slice pos len), pos + len)

def encodeTensor (ba : ByteArray) (t : ZTensor) : ByteArray := do
  let mut b := ba
  b := encodeU64LE b t.shape.length
  for d in t.shape do
    b := encodeU64LE b d
  b := encodeU64LE b t.size
  for i in [:t.size] do
    b := encodeF32Bits b (← readF32 (t.dataPtr + i))
  b

def decodeTensor (ba : ByteArray) (pos : Nat) : Except ZigError (ZTensor × Nat) := do
  let (ndim, p) ← decodeU64LE ba pos
  let mut shape : List Nat := []
  let mut pp := p
  for _ in [:ndim.val] do
    let (d, q) ← decodeU64LE ba pp
    shape := shape ++ [d.val]
    pp := q
  let (size, q) ← decodeU64LE ba pp
  let mut data : Array F32 := #[]
  pp := q
  for _ in [:size.val] do
    let (f, r) ← decodeF32Bits ba pp
    data := data.push f
    pp := r
  let addr ← allocF32Array size.val
  for i in [:size.val] do
    writeF32 (addr + i) data[i]
  .ok ({ dataPtr := addr, size := size.val, shape := shape }, pp)
